title: Rollback Plan
description: Schema for the Rollback_Plan.md structured data. Mandatory Gate 6 companion artifact. Missing or incomplete Rollback_Plan triggers BLOCKED_NO_ROLLBACK_PLAN.

feature_name.description: Name of the feature or release this rollback plan covers.

prepared_date.description: Date this rollback plan was prepared.

deployment_id_to_rollback_to.description: Vercel deployment ID of the last known-good deployment to roll back to. Required when known.

rollback_trigger_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger rollback execution. At minimum: healthcheck failure, error rate breach, smoke test failure, manual trigger.

condition.description: The observable condition that triggers rollback.

threshold.description: The specific threshold value (e.g., '3 consecutive failures', '> 5% for 10 minutes').

action.description: Required action when condition is met.

application_rollback_steps.description: Ordered steps to roll back the application via Vercel dashboard.

verification.description: How to verify this step completed successfully.

database_rollback_strategy.description: Database rollback strategy. Must be forward-fix — no backward migrations.

has_destructive_migrations.description: True if this release includes destructive database operations.

forward_fix_description.description: Description of the forward-fix migration that undoes the change, or 'N/A — no database changes in this release'.

forward_fix_migration_file.description: Name of the prepared forward-fix migration file (if applicable).

estimated_db_rollback_minutes.description: Estimated time for database rollback (forward-fix application).

data_recovery_possible.description: True if any dropped data can be recovered from backup.

post_rollback_validation.description: Validation steps to confirm rollback success.

expected_result.description: The expected outcome if rollback was successful.

application_minutes.description: Time to roll back the application via Vercel.

database_minutes.description: Time to execute forward-fix migration (if applicable).

validation_minutes.description: Time to run post-rollback smoke tests and validation.

rollback_owner.description: Role responsible for executing the rollback (e.g., 'Tech Lead (on-call)', 'DevOps Engineer (human)').

rollback_procedure_tested.description: True if the rollback procedure has been verified in staging before production deployment.

rollback_procedure_tested_date.description: Date the rollback procedure was tested in staging.

tech_lead_notification_channel.description: How to notify the Tech Lead when rollback is triggered (e.g., 'Slack #incidents channel + direct message').
